emails.subject: Seeking seed investors for Indian green loans platform
emails.body:
Hi David,

Quona Capital's focus on fintech innovators advancing financial inclusion aligns with my work as co-founder of a climate-fintech platform. We match Indian MSMEs with green loans and have onboarded 1,200 MSMEs, disbursing Rs 9 crore.

Currently, we are raising a $1.5M seed round to scale further. I am looking for seed investors interested in investing $100k-$500k in climate or fintech sectors in India, Singapore, or Indonesia.

Could you point me to seed investors at Quona Capital who might be interested or to whoever handles this?

Best regards,
Test Founder

emails.subject: Seeking seed investors in climate fintech
emails.body:
Hello Init-6 team,

I co-founded a climate-fintech startup that matches Indian MSMEs with green loans. We have onboarded 1,200 MSMEs and disbursed Rs 9 crore so far.

We are currently raising a $1.5M seed round and are looking for investors interested in contributing $100k-$500k in climate or fintech sectors in India, Singapore, or Indonesia. 

Could you please point me to seed investors in your network who focus on these sectors and investment sizes, excluding corporate venture arms and accelerators? Your guidance would be very helpful.

Best regards,
Test Founder
